headline: 840 children died from measles symptoms across Bangladesh
summary: Three more children died in 24 hours, bringing the total death toll to 840 since March 15, according to the DGHS.
details: Three more children died from measles symptoms across the country in the last 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
In the same period, 872 new cases were reported, with 121 of those being confirmed measles patients.
Since March 15, a total of 840 children have died from measles symptoms, including 744 with symptoms and 96 confirmed cases.
The total number of people showing measles symptoms since March 15 has reached 129,610, while 16,180 have been confirmed as measles patients.
Hospitalizations have been high, with 111,674 people admitted to hospitals with measles symptoms since mid-March.
Of those admitted, 107,397 patients have recovered and been discharged from hospitals.
